simplify.result: 85 unique listing additions or active-state changes were reviewed. Four were Dallas/Austin-related: new CDK Global JR9204, UT Southwestern 973896 and Intel JR0288224 records, plus Allen Control Systems Systems Test Engineer changing active true to false.

officialVerification.result: Official Workday page displayed Apply, Austin hybrid, Posted Today, 0–2 years, NodeJS/ReactJS/AWS and $85,000–$95,000. Work focuses on general product software and AI-assisted coding. Official language requires no current or future employment-based visa sponsorship, triggering the monitor’s authorization exclusion; compensation and direction do not clearly beat Ryan.

Official Taleo page displayed Apply Online and a 2026-10-22 posting time. A relevant bachelor’s degree can satisfy the role with no experience, but duties are EMR data, regulatory reporting, extraction/validation/summarization and clinical quality support. This is not Applied AI/ML/Data Science and has no disclosed pay or clear Ryan upgrade.

Aggregator changed active true to false, while the company’s official careers surface still listed the Austin role. Core work is system-level test execution for autonomous weapon platforms, a hardware/defense test direction that is excluded. No tracked-job record was changed; closure was not declared.

Upstream record lists Austin among locations and classifies the role as hardware. The official Workday dynamic page did not render usable JD text in this run. It was excluded at title/category level under the hardware rule and was not added to jobs.json or treated as fully verified.
